spec.name: Furniture Sewing Desk
spec.description: A cozy oak sewing desk with a prominent black vintage sewing machine, orange thread spool and folded teal cloth. Connected, axis-aligned construction fits within the requested two-block footprint; front faces negative Z. Unique cube nets preserve native texel density.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: oak sewing desk with a black vintage sewing machine, orange spool and folded teal cloth; the machine is the clear focal point. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
